name: CoA super-track patch: the Hyena Spirit turn-in point follows its moved spawn
contract: The client's SuperTrack.dbc places point 8705, the turn-in of 1660034, 1660035 and 1660043, at the old spawn.
The login patch stream sends coa_client_super_track rows as SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BE) records.
Row 8705 carries map 1 and the Hyena Spirit's position (-3619.49, -959.45, 205.057) as float words.
Socketless packet construction does not establish how the client renders the waypoint.

steps.label: The login stream sends SuperTrack row 8705 once
Row 8705 x is the Hyena Spirit's -3619.49
Row 8705 y is the Hyena Spirit's -959.45
